generation_prompt: The robot uses its right hand to grasp the ear of corn around its pale husk on the right side of the table and lift it clear. It carries the corn upward over the two-tiered wooden shelf, lowers it into the upper tray, and opens its hand, leaving the corn resting across the wooden slats. Keep the camera fixed; preserve robot geometry, physically valid joint motion, and normal gripper opening and closing.
observed_terminal_state: Corn rests across the slats inside the upper wooden tray. The right hand is open just above/beside it, and the left hand remains open in the foreground.

arm_hand_roles.right: Sole active manipulator: closes fingers/thumb around corn, lifts, transports upward, lowers into the upper tray and opens to release.
arm_hand_roles.left: Remains open near the left foreground; does not grasp, stabilize or transfer corn.

uncertainties: Full shoulder attachments are outside the egocentric view; hand sides are established from paired forearm positions and palm/thumb geometry. Exact finger-to-husk contact surfaces are partly occluded by the hand.

data_quality_gate.rule: Variance of the Laplacian of the luma of the model-view frame (cover-resize to the nearest-aspect 720p-class bucket, center crop); pass if >= 120 third-person, >= 60 first-person.
